extension.description: The product-by-product input-output table at basic prices shows, for each product category, the monetary flows of supply and use within the economy. The table is compiled according to ESA 2010 and follows the CPA 2.1 product classification. It records output, intermediate consumption, final uses, imports and value added, allowing detailed analyses of production structures, inter-industry linkages and the generation of gross domestic product. Table naio_10_pyp1700 reports all transactions at previous year's prices.
